name: oMLX
description: Serve local MLX models with continuous batching, tiered memory/SSD caching, and menu-bar management.
compatibility: MLX model serving; optional MCP support.
limitations: Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or newer; source installs require Python 3.11-3.13.
Some model families require custom Metal kernels; use the packaged app or follow the full Xcode build requirements.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
